authorization: User explicitly authorized two independent security publishers agreeing on the vulnerability class, with Codex reasoning documented
adjudication_basis: BlockSec identifies manipulation of the oracle used by Inverse. PeckShield explains that LP pricing misuses manipulable pool balances. Both independently diagnose an oracle-price dependency; the flash loan magnifies it. It is not labeled reentrancy or assigned an unrelated SWC category.

independent_observations.mechanism_excerpt: The root cause is that the price oracle utilized by Inverse Finance has been manipulated.
The hack is made possible due to the price oracle manipulation, which misuses the balances of assets in the pool
